quick.finding: Global language control is inert during native modal consultation; tests bypass pointer reachability.
quick.evidence: App renders only toolbar LanguageControl; FilePreview narrow/expanded and AgentInfoPanel narrow call showModal. HTMLmodal makes toolbar inert; languageUI evaluate(button.click) explicitly avoids native reachability.
quick.smallestFix: Reuse same existing language command/provider in active modal headers, without new state, port, handler or authority; actual user pointer/keyboard tests keep same consultation/source/selection.

quick.finding: Established GraphCoordinator reasons fall through untranslated technical fallback under EN.
quick.evidence: Coordinator emits exact unreadable-store/stale-reference sentences; GraphPanel passes them to diagnostic slot, whose closed dictionary/prefixes lack those established sentences.
quick.smallestFix: Complete closed own-graph reason mappings and bounded parameter template, keep raw technical parameters and unknown fallback exact.

quick.finding: Partial library and directly appended progress errors retain known French diagnostics under EN.
quick.evidence: projectLibrary concatenates snapshot.problems into library limit and adds value.error. Library slot only translates prefix; known diagnostic templates are searched only in diagnostic slot. Existing snapshot problems array is available in entry.evidence.
quick.smallestFix: Render own partial prefix with existing structured problems through diagnostic presenter; do not split arbitrary technical strings or edit producers. Present established progress errors through bounded mappings, preserve exact parameters.

quick.finding: Raw numeric counts and fixed plurals leave singulars and grouped numbers unlocalized.
quick.evidence: Help Bundle unconditionally renders documents.length plus documents loaded and problems.length plus issues reported, e.g.1documents; graph uses fixed plurals and raw counts; formatCount exists but is unused at those sites.
quick.smallestFix: Apply existing explicitlocale formatters to UI-owned counts/byte sizes/plurals only, pair FR/EN forms without touching identifiers/raw values.
